 Holiday Melodies Return to Carlsbad Village with Musical Kickoff to the Holidays
 Blog Post - November 17, 2026 
 Category:
 What's New 
 The sounds of the season are returning to Carlsbad Village! On Friday, December 4, beginning at 5:00 PM , the Fountain Parking Lot will come alive with festive music, talented young performers, and holiday cheer as the Carlsbad Village Association presents Musical Kickoff to the Holidays , a free, family-friendly celebration for all ages.
 Get ready for an evening of holiday favorites performed by some of Carlsbad’s most talented young musicians! Carlsbad Unified School District’s middle and high school choirs, orchestras, and jazz ensembles will help fill the Village with everything from traditional carols to lively jazz arrangements.
 The Carlsbad High School Holiday Jazz Ensemble will bring its festive energy and musical talent to the celebration. Last year’s event also showcased wonderful performances by small groups from Aviara Oaks, Calavera Hills, and Valley Middle Schools , along with Carlsbad High School Carolers and chamber ensembles from Carlsbad and Sage Creek High Schools . Together, these talented student musicians represent the incredible music programs and creativity found throughout our community.
 And what better way to enjoy holiday music than with a warm cup of cocoa and a sweet treat? Stop by the hot cocoa and cookie station as you enjoy the performances and soak up the festive atmosphere.
 For the evening, the Fountain Parking Lot will transform into a welcoming holiday gathering place, complete with twinkling lights, seasonal decorations, and the joyful sounds of live music. It’s a wonderful opportunity for families, friends, and neighbors to come together, celebrate local talent, and enjoy the magic of the season.
 While Carlsbad Village continues to look forward to a permanent public gathering space, events like Musical Kickoff to the Holidays show how music and community can transform an everyday space into something truly special.
 The full musical program and performance times will be announced soon. 
 Come early, explore the Village’s unique shops and restaurants, enjoy something sweet, and celebrate the incredible young musicians who help make Carlsbad such a special community. There’s no better way to kick off the holiday season than with music, neighbors, and a little Village magic!
